name: rocket
description: Staged agent workflows: a router picks the right flow for features, bugfixes, reviews, tests, small changes and questions, with approval gates and safety hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Staged workflows with approval gates for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Start every task with the rocket router. It picks launch (feature/refactor), fix, review, test, small or what, runs the matching stages, waits at approval gates and blocks quitting before the interactive test or shipping before approval.
